speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic, I am Dr. Agent. You are here for dizziness, nausea, and imbalance; to help me narrow this down, have you ever experienced sudden, severe headaches or loss of consciousness alongside these symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: 27-year-old male. The patient reports a sustained sensation of the room spinning since this morning, which is low grade and constant. He occasionally feels nauseous and has taken diphenhydramine to help him sleep, which also alleviates his symptoms slightly. He mentions recent increased intake of garlic due to trying to recover from a cold a few days ago. Past medical history is unremarkable.

speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV)

The negative MRI and non-specific audiometry help rule out stroke or central causes, and your symptoms are consistent with BPPV. Can you confirm if your dizziness is strictly triggered by turning your head in bed or looking up? REQUEST TEST: Dix-Hallpike Maneuver.
